name: twrses-life
description: 生命與生態 Living Things 3D 模型的原始碼與打包設定。產物寫到 assets/js/，npm run build 重新打包。

scripts.build: esbuild src/life-leaf.js src/life-cell.js src/life-dna.js src/life-germ.js src/life-seed.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --outdir=../../assets/js
scripts.test: node test/photo.test.mjs && node test/cell.test.mjs && node test/dna.test.mjs && node test/germ.test.mjs && node test/seed.test.mjs
